_schema.description: Optional dated annotations displayed independently of player performance. Keys are player display names. Profile fields record only documented public self-identification or sourced affiliation; unknown denomination remains Unknown. Events do not claim causation with performance.

profile.basis: Publicly discusses his Christian faith and relationship with Jesus; no denomination established by the sources currently in the dataset.

events.title: Mayfield later identifies 2020 PAO involvement as important in his Christian faith
events.note: In a later Sports Spectrum interview, Mayfield said that joining Professional Athletes Outreach with his wife in February 2020 was an important point in the strengthening of his Christian faith. The date is month-level and uses the first day as a plotting anchor.

profile.basis: Stroud publicly describes himself as a follower of Christ and has repeatedly discussed his Christian faith. Available sources identify a Christian upbringing but do not establish a denomination.

events.title: Stroud discusses finding Christ for himself in college
events.note: In a pre-draft interview discussed by Faith on the Field, Stroud described growing up in church, falling away as a child, and coming to know Christ for himself in college.

events.title: Stroud publicly credits prayer and God's grace after Cincinnati win
events.note: After Houston's win at Cincinnati, Stroud discussed prayer, God's grace and mercy, and said his platform is about God's glory rather than himself.

profile.basis: Henderson publicly identifies his faith in Jesus Christ and has given Christian testimony; no denomination is established by the sources currently in the dataset.

events.title: Henderson participates in Ohio State campus faith event
events.note: Henderson was among Ohio State players speaking at a large campus Christian gathering where more than 50 students were baptized. The source identifies the event as occurring in August; the first day is used as a plotting anchor.

events.title: Henderson discusses his testimony and identity in Jesus
events.note: Sports Spectrum published a podcast episode in which Henderson discussed his Ohio State transformation, sharing his faith as an NFL player, his testimony, and identity in Jesus.

events.title: Henderson says he will continue publicly sharing his Christian faith
events.note: Speaking to reporters, Henderson discussed criticism of his religious posts and said he intended to continue sharing his faith in Jesus.
